evidence.observation: 1.7 ppm at start of growth, consistent with ~1-4 ppm during ramp
Rose steadily to 25.3 ppm across 6 growth events
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so purge flow did not drop
Holding at 750 °C, heater power steady at ~44%
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere cannot be checked by pressure

args.missing_evidence: No tube pressure reading exists to tell a seal leak (pressure normal or low) from an exhaust blockage or back-diffusion (pressure high). A leak check on the fittings or a temporary pressure gauge would settle it. No characterization of the sample yet.
